description: This file defines a namespace 'Thunder::Core' containing template classes for parsing text and path manipulation, including 'ParserType', 'TextParser', and 'PathParser'. It includes class declarations, enums, and method signatures related to parsing operations.

classes.name: ParserType
classes.description: A template class for parsing text streams with customizable terminators and handlers, managing parsing states, buffer, and position.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class for parsing text fragments, providing methods to read text, numbers, enumerations, key-value pairs, and ranges.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class for parsing filesystem paths into drive, directory, filename, base filename, and extension components.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state and position.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current byte position in the stream.

methods.name: CollectWord
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a word, optionally with a split character and case state.

methods.name: CollectLine
methods.description: Configures the parser to collect a line.

methods.name: FlushLine
methods.description: Sets the parser to flush the current line.

methods.name: PassThrough
methods.description: Configures the parser to pass through a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a stream of bytes into parser state, handling pass-through, line flushing, and token parsing.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text from a fragment, considering delimiters.

methods.name: ReadNumber
methods.description: Reads a number of specified type from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadEnumerate
methods.description: Reads an enumeration value from the text fragment.

methods.name: ReadKeyValuePair
methods.description: Reads a key-value pair from the text fragment, separated by a specified divider.

methods.name: ReadRange
methods.description: Reads a range of numbers from the text fragment.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a specified number of positions or characters.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Finds specified characters in the text fragment.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the text fragment against a comparison, case-sensitive or insensitive.

methods.name: Drive
methods.description: Returns the drive component of a path.

methods.name: Path
methods.description: Returns the directory path component.

methods.name: FileName
methods.description: Returns the filename component.

methods.name: BaseFileName
methods.description: Returns the base filename without extension.

methods.name: Extension
methods.description: Returns the file extension.
